from datasets import load_dataset
from collections import Counter
import json

ds = load_dataset("Rtian/DebugBench")["test"]

# 1. 语言分布
languages = [row["language"] for row in ds]
lang_counts = Counter(languages)
print("=== Language Distribution ===")
for lang, cnt in lang_counts.most_common():
    print(f"  {lang}: {cnt}")

# 2. Category 分布
categories = [row["category"] for row in ds]
cat_counts = Counter(categories)
print("\n=== Category Distribution ===")
for cat, cnt in cat_counts.most_common():
    print(f"  {cat}: {cnt}")

# 3. Python 子集分析
py_rows = [row for row in ds if row["language"].lower() == "python"]
print(f"\n=== Python Subset ===")
print(f"Total Python samples: {len(py_rows)}")

# Bug type (category) 分布
py_cats = Counter(row["category"] for row in py_rows)
print("\nPython - Category distribution:")
for cat, cnt in py_cats.most_common():
    print(f"  {cat}: {cnt}")

# Subtype 分布
py_subtypes = Counter(row["subtype"] for row in py_rows)
print("\nPython - Subtype distribution:")
for st, cnt in py_subtypes.most_common():
    print(f"  {st}: {cnt}")

# Level/difficulty 分布
py_levels = Counter(row["level"] for row in py_rows)
print("\nPython - Level distribution:")
for lv, cnt in py_levels.most_common():
    print(f"  {lv}: {cnt}")

# 字段长度统计
import statistics

buggy_lens = [len(row["buggy_code"]) for row in py_rows]
solution_lens = [len(row["solution"]) for row in py_rows]
question_lens = [len(row["question"]) for row in py_rows]
example_counts = [len(row["examples"]) for row in py_rows]
bug_expl_lens = [len(row["bug_explanation"]) for row in py_rows]

print("\nPython - Field length stats:")
for name, vals in [
    ("buggy_code", buggy_lens),
    ("solution", solution_lens),
    ("question", question_lens),
    ("bug_explanation", bug_expl_lens),
]:
    print(f"  {name}: mean={statistics.mean(vals):.0f}, median={statistics.median(vals):.0f}, min={min(vals)}, max={max(vals)}")

print(f"  examples count: mean={statistics.mean(example_counts):.1f}, min={min(example_counts)}, max={max(example_counts)}")

# 4. 全量 level 分布
all_levels = Counter(row["level"] for row in ds)
print("\n=== All - Level Distribution ===")
for lv, cnt in all_levels.most_common():
    print(f"  {lv}: {cnt}")

# 5. 全量 subtype 分布
all_subtypes = Counter(row["subtype"] for row in ds)
print("\n=== All - Subtype Distribution (top 20) ===")
for st, cnt in all_subtypes.most_common(20):
    print(f"  {st}: {cnt}")
PYEOF
